intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create an independently authored, arm-specific, random and complex photorealistic test scene that uses the attached portrait only for facial and general appearance continuity, preserves a clear full-body wardrobe inspection surface, and leaves all wardrobe specifics open for a later isolated phase.

Photograph a complex photorealistic test concept in an underground book-conservation lab after a sprinkler alarm. Show one unmistakably adult woman whose facial and general appearance echoes the attached portrait: long deep-brown wavy hair with a centered part, a softly oval face, dark brown eyes, and a calm focused presence. In a narrow dry inspection lane, she steadies a waterlogged illuminated folio on a transparent suction table positioned beside her while emergency humidity strips curl and amber alarm light ripples across shallow puddles. Keep her arms separated from her torso and arrange the transparent support, folio, and examination table laterally, leaving every clothing region directly visible. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Surround her with stainless worktables, translucent drying racks, archival rescue crates, dehumidifier hoses, plastic-draped shelving, suspended droplets, and warm alarm reflections against cool utility light. Render tactile wet paper fibers, clear support edges, concrete sheen, humid air, and restrained editorial realism.

Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces.
